column3: NASB moves “the prophet” next to “Zechariah”; “in the eighth month in year two” is rendered “of the second year.”
“Was angry … anger” is rendered “was very angry,” and “ancestors” “fathers.”
“And you will say” is rendered “Therefore say.”
“Turn back” is rendered “Return now,” and “paid attention” “give heed.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Nevertheless” is rendered “But,” and “planned” “purposed”; “so he has done” is rendered “so He has dealt.”
“One plus ten month” is rendered “the eleventh month,” and “it was” “which is”; NASB adds “as follows.”
“The night” is rendered “at night,” and “hollow” “ravine.”
NASB moves “My lord” to the front.
“Go about” is rendered “patrol.”
“Go about” is rendered “patrolled”; “dwelling and undisturbed” is rendered “peaceful and quiet.”
“This seventy years” is rendered “these seventy years.”
“Good words, words of comforts” is rendered “gracious words, comforting words.”
“Jealous … jealousy great” is rendered “exceedingly jealous.”
“Anger great I am angry” is rendered “I am very angry”; “they have helped for evil” is rendered “they furthered the disaster.”
“I have returned” is rendered “I will return,” and “rebuilt” “built.”
“From good” is rendered “with prosperity.”
MT 2:1. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 2:2. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 2:3. Close to the Hebrew.
MT 2:4. “According to the mouth of a man” is rendered “so that no man”; NASB supplies “craftsmen.”
